title: Show
description: A named podcast show within the HOSPES multi-tenant system. Each Show has its own DNA (segment structure, visual grammar, editorial voice, studio defaults) declared as configuration. The Show is the tenancy boundary for AppearanceOpportunities, Episodes, and Studios. A network-level Relationship is not automatically usable by every Show — Show-level access requires explicit configuration.

show_id.description: Stable UUID or slug for this show.

network_id.description: The Network or tenant this show belongs to.

show_type.description: Show format classification. 'field_show' activates the Place→Object→Intervention→Artifact segment logic.

dna_config_path.description: Path or reference to the Show DNA configuration file (show_dna.yaml or equivalent). Defines segment deck, visual grammar, editorial voice.

default_studio_ids.description: Ordered list of studio_ids representing this show's default recording locations by priority.

rss_feed_url.description: Public RSS feed URL. Used for archive ingestion and guest-graph seeding.
